subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust these exact new action revisions in workflows that mint tokens, consume secrets, publish images, upload security results, or execute Codex agents?
rationale: The changes are mechanically coherent, but accepting new executable revisions in privileged workflows is a security-boundary decision that CI and automated review cannot make alone.

options.title: Approve after complete verification
options.body: Accept the grouped revisions after direct upstream and Codex-source review plus a complete check run on the final rebased head.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, container-publishing, and Codex action updates for narrower ownership review.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Pause the PR until exact revision provenance and reliable exact-head validation are available.

recommendation.title: Approve after complete verification
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped revisions after direct upstream and Codex-source review plus a complete check run on the final rebased head.
